3t8964.text: 3T8964 has been fighting barely two months and already turns heads: the matchups run well clear of average, resistance holds as enemies improve, and the kill-death spread in faceoffs sits near the summit. Their aim sits with the sharpest few — yet headshots stay scarce, and the edge thins against the strongest third. The lifetime board sits mid-pack so far. Early days, and the start has been loud.

3dvian.text: 3Dvian plays fast and finishes clean: upper-tier overall, a top-shelf tempo, and unflinching against stronger opposition. The head-to-head record leans winning, and the headshots sit near the very top. The lifetime IvI line climbs there too, which makes this one of the sharper cards in the pack — quick, accurate, and hard to shake.
